greeting: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. May the grace and peace of our Lord Jesus Christ, who guides us by the light of His Spirit, be with you all.
penitential:
Lord Jesus, you call us to look beyond the surface of our lives to the truth within. Lord, have mercy.
Christ Jesus, you offer us the fruit of the Spirit instead of the burdens of the law. Christ, have mercy.
Lord Jesus, you are the light that guides us through every shadow. Lord, have mercy.
psalm_response: Those who follow you, Lord, will have the light of life.
homily:
We often think of the law as a map. We imagine that if we can just find the right path, if we can just mark off the correct coordinates and keep our feet on the narrow, prescribed trail, we will arrive safely at the destination. We spend so much of our lives measuring our progress by these external markers—the tithes of mint and rue, the specific ways we present ourselves to the world, the rigid structures we build to keep chaos at bay. We are like the Pharisees in today’s Gospel, so careful to measure the garden herbs, so meticulous about the appearance of our righteousness, yet often forgetting the very thing that makes the journey worth taking: the weightier matters of judgment and the love of God.

But notice where Jesus directs our attention. He does not tell us to stop being careful; he tells us to stop being hollow. He speaks to those who love the seats of honor in the synagogues and the greetings in the marketplaces, and he warns them that they are like unseen graves over which people unknowingly walk. It is a startling, even jarring image. A grave is a place where we think life has ended, a place we avoid, a place that holds the memory of what once was. To be like an 'unseen grave' is to carry a hidden emptiness inside while presenting a polished exterior to the world. It is the exhaustion of trying to be strong when we are hollow, of trying to be right when we are broken.

St. Paul, writing to the Galatians, offers us the only way out of this trap. He says, 'If you are guided by the Spirit, you are not under the law.' He contrasts the 'works of the flesh'—hatreds, rivalries, outbursts of fury, the things that tear us apart—with the 'fruit of the Spirit': love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, generosity, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control. This is not a list of chores. This is not a new set of laws to follow. This is a description of the life of God as it begins to take root in a human heart. It is the difference between a tree that is merely standing in the ground and a tree that is planted near running water, yielding fruit in due season, its leaves never fading.

Benjamin Vo was a boy who lived as if he were planted by those waters. Think of the way his mind worked—not as a machine, but as a garden. He possessed a brilliant, analytical intellect, yes; he could navigate the complexities of AI and cloud infrastructure with a sophistication that amazed those around him. But his life was never defined by the 'works of the flesh'—the rivalry or the envy that so often consumes the world of the clever. No, he was defined by that gentle spirit that seemed to flow from him naturally, like a stream. He was a boy who loved the mechanics of 'con chim airlines,' who giggled at the thought of his own little aviation company, not because he wanted to conquer the world, but because he wanted to be part of the beauty of flight. He was a boy who saw the world as a vast, open space to be explored, not a grid to be dominated.

Alan and Thao, I know that for these four months, the silence of your home has been a heavy companion. You remember the way Ben would come to you with his ideas, his plans, his gentle smile. You remember the way he would listen—truly listen—to the stories his dad would tell, finding joy in the simple, quiet connection of a father and son. That bond is not a thing of the past. It is a living, breathing reality. It is the 'fruit of the Spirit' that Paul speaks of, which is not subject to the laws of time or decay. You are a family of four, and that is a truth that death cannot touch, because it is anchored in the promise of the One who is the Resurrection and the Life.

Sometimes, the weight of a life that has been completed so early feels like an impossible burden. You look at the empty space where he should be, and you wonder how to keep going. You might even feel a flicker of guilt, a thought that maybe you should have done more, or seen more, or held him tighter. I want to lift that stone from your hearts today. You were the parents Benjamin needed. You were his sanctuary. You were the ones who nurtured that brilliant, curious, gentle spirit. You did not miss anything. God does not look at your son’s life and find it lacking, and He does not look at your care for him and find it wanting. You are not being accused. You are being held. Let that stone fall. You are free to grieve, you are free to miss him, but you are not required to carry the burden of self-reproach. That is a weight that has no place in the kingdom of God. You are loved without limit, and you are being held by the same hands that hold him.

Ryan, you are a brother who knows the secret language of that love. You know that Ben is not gone; he has simply gone ahead to the place where all the 'con chim airlines' finally take flight. You are the one who carries the legacy of his curiosity, his kindness, and his smile. When you sit down to code, or when you look up at the clouds, know that you are not doing it alone. You are a family of four, and that bond is stronger than death. Keep being the boy who reaches out. Keep being the brother who knows that the most important things in life are not the things we possess, but the love we share. You are a witness to the fact that love is the only thing that actually lasts.

Look at the Gospel again. Jesus says, 'But as to what is within, give alms, and behold, everything will be clean for you.' This is the secret of the Christian life. We cleanse the inside not by scrubbing it, but by giving it away. We give our love, we give our time, we give our attention to others. When we pour ourselves out, the interior of our soul becomes clear. We stop worrying about our own emptiness and start focusing on the needs of our brothers and sisters. That is why the Well of Love in Vietnam is such a powerful, living sign of Benjamin’s life. It is his love, still flowing. It is his kindness, still quenching the thirst of those who are far away. Every time you are kind, every time you choose to hope in the face of despair, you are allowing his legacy to refresh the world. You are turning the soil of the earth so that the Kingdom can grow.

Do not be afraid of the silence, and do not be afraid of the ache. That ache is simply your love looking for a place to land. Let it land on the promise of the Resurrection. Let it land on the certainty that Benjamin is not in the past; he is in the future. He is at the destination, waiting for you to complete the journey. He is not in the dust. He is in the light. He is waiting for you, and he is watching over you with that same sweet, gentle smile that you remember so vividly. That smile is a sign. It is a sign that the harvest is coming, and that the One who started this good work in you will surely bring it to completion.

There is a profound freedom in realizing that we do not have to hold it all together. We do not have to be the ones who provide the answers. We are children of the freeborn woman. We are heirs to a kingdom that is not built by human hands, but by the grace of God. That grace is the 'bread' we need for the journey. It is the strength that comes when our own strength is gone. It is the peace that settles over us when we finally stop fighting the silence and start listening to the voice of the Father.

So today, carry this away with you: you are never alone. You are a family that is being held by the same hands that hold the universe. When you see a bird in flight, or a plane climbing into the clouds, don't just see a machine or a creature; see a sign of the freedom that Benjamin now knows. See a sign of the promise that you are walking toward. Keep your eyes on the horizon. The journey is not over; it is simply continuing in a new, more glorious way. And one day, when the long road reaches the end, you will look up and see him waiting for you, and the joy will be beyond all reckoning.

Take this with you: you are a family of four, and that will never change. The geography of your life has shifted, but the bond of your love is eternal. Keep the 'Well of Love' flowing in his name. Keep the kindness moving. Keep the dream alive. And when you walk out those doors, look up at the sky. Remember that he is not in the dust. He is in the light. He is waiting for you, and he is watching over you with that same sweet, gentle smile that you remember so vividly. That smile is a sign. It is a sign that the harvest is coming, and that the One who started this good work in you will surely bring it to completion. You are loved without limit, and you are being held by the same hands that hold him. Amen.
spiritual_communion: My Jesus, I believe that You are present in the Most Holy Sacrament. I love You above all things, and I desire to receive You into my soul. Since I cannot at this moment receive You sacramentally, come at least spiritually into my heart. I embrace You as if You were already there and unite myself wholly to You. Never permit me to be separated from You. Amen.
closing: May the Lord bless you and keep you in His light, and may the peace of Christ, which surpasses all understanding, guard your hearts and minds today and always. Go in peace.
standing_petitions: For our beloved Ben and all who have gone before us, that they may rest forever in the radiant light of Christ's presence, we pray to the Lord.
For all who carry the heavy cross of grief, that they may be consoled by the promise of the Resurrection and feel the nearness of God's love, we pray to the Lord.

readings.label: Reading 1
readings.text:
Brothers and sisters:
If you are guided by the Spirit, you are not under the law.
Now the works of the flesh are obvious:
immorality, impurity, licentiousness, idolatry,
sorcery, hatreds, rivalry, jealousy,
outbursts of fury, acts of selfishness,
dissensions, factions, occasions of envy,
drinking bouts, orgies, and the like.
I warn you, as I warned you before,
that those who do such things will not inherit the Kingdom of God.
In contrast, the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace,
patience, kindness, generosity,
faithfulness, gentleness, self-control.
Against such there is no law.
Now those who belong to Christ Jesus have crucified their flesh
with its passions and desires.
If we live in the Spirit, let us also follow the Spirit.

readings.label: Responsorial Psalm
readings.text:
R. (see Jn 8:12) Those who follow you, Lord, will have the light of life.
Blessed the man who follows not
the counsel of the wicked
Nor walks in the way of sinners,
nor sits in the company of the insolent,
But delights in the law of the LORD
and meditates on his law day and night.
R. Those who follow you, Lord, will have the light of life.
He is like a tree
planted near running water,
That yields its fruit in due season,
and whose leaves never fade.
Whatever he does, prospers.
R. Those who follow you, Lord, will have the light of life.
Not so the wicked, not so;
they are like chaff which the wind drives away.
For the LORD watches over the way of the just,
but the way of the wicked vanishes.
R. Those who follow you, Lord, will have the light of life.

readings.label: Gospel
readings.text:
The Lord said:
“Woe to you Pharisees!
You pay tithes of mint and of rue and of every garden herb,
but you pay no attention to judgment and to love for God.
These you should have done, without overlooking the others.
Woe to you Pharisees!
You love the seat of honor in synagogues
and greetings in marketplaces.  
Woe to you!
You are like unseen graves over which people unknowingly walk.”Then one of the scholars of the law said to him in reply,
“Teacher, by saying this you are insulting us too.”
And he said, “Woe also to you scholars of the law!
You impose on people burdens hard to carry,
but you yourselves do not lift one finger to touch them.”

day: Wednesday of the Twenty-eighth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben
